lines.trans: On the day of his arrest, Anikeev met with Samsonov.
We received copies of all important records.
In the mayor's office there was a hidden camera.
That is all the information obtained.
Understood, I got your point.
And where is Major Lavrov right now?
Major Lavrov is writing a report right now.
Tell him not to be difficult.
I will not accept any report from him!
In short, we continue our operation.
Is everything clear to you, Captain?
Yes sir, Comrade General, everything is clear!
That is it, he disconnected the call.
Now we can calmly continue our work.

examples.trans: We've been dating for a month.

лезть.gloss: to climb; to push in, to barge in

meanings.note: лезть на дерево = to climb a tree

meanings.en: to push in, to barge in

colloquial: не лезь! = keep out of it!

examples.trans: The cat is climbing the tree.

отключиться.gloss: to disconnect, hang up, turn off

meanings.en: to disconnect, hang up the call

передать.gloss: to pass on, to hand over

meanings.en: to pass on, to hand over, to give

examples.trans: Please pass on my regards to your mum.

принять.gloss: to receive, to see (a visitor); to accept

meanings.note: imperative particle expressing permission or concession

examples.trans: The major is writing a resignation report.
